About these 15 rides

Starts run from 5:30 am to 10:30 am. The group waits for everyone on 8 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 6. There are 2 rides made for LGBTQ+ riders, 1 for women, trans and femme riders, 2 for BIPOC riders and 2 for families. By bike: 11 road, 5 social and 1 gravel. They run 11 every week, 3 once a month and 1 on dates posted one at a time. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Nov 9, 2026.
